artworks.title: A Cove with a Sailboat
artworks.medium: pen and black ink on heavy wove paper (invitation card)
artworks.description: The image shows a distant cityscape with a central scene. The composition includes a body of water with a sailboat to the right. The drawing features simple and loose pencil or pen strokes in a quick, gestural style. The color palette is monochromatic, using neutral tones of the paper and dark ink or graphite. Above the horizon line, there are swift lines indicating clouds or distant birds in the sky.

artworks.title: The Woman in the “Song of Songs”
artworks.medium: black chalk with white heightening on blue wove paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a person standing barefoot with their legs crossed, leaning forward with arms resting on a horizontal surface. The person has a calm expression, a pointed nose, and shoulder-length hair partially covered by a head wrap. They wear a long robe-like garment cinched at the waist. The background is plain, with the person as the central focus. The artwork has a sketch-like quality on light blue paper.

artworks.title: A Middle Eastern Woman Reclining in an Exotic Setting
artworks.medium: graphite with watercolor on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a woman reclining on a lounge. She is leaning her head on her hand, which rests on a patterned pillow. Her long dark hair is adorned with a decorative headdress. She is wearing a long garment with ornate patterns. Around her are a hookah, a small table with items, and a decorative object. The background features draped curtains and an arched design.

artworks.title: Calligraphic Flowers
artworks.artist: Jean-Joseph Bernard called Bernard de Paris
artworks.medium: pen and brown and iron gall ink with watercolor on laid paper

artworks.title: A Convivial Gathering with a Man Playing a Hurdy-Gurdy
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash over black chalk on wove paper
artworks.description: This is a sepia-toned ink and wash drawing on paper depicting a group of figures in motion. The figures are dressed in historical costumes with wide-brimmed hats and flowing garments. The loose and gestural lines suggest movement and energy, while cross-hatching creates depth and shadow. The scene is lively and dramatic, with figures leaning in different directions.

artworks.title: Saints Peter and Paul
artworks.medium: pen and brown and iron gall ink, with brown wash over black chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: The image illustrates two figures in full length with their bodies posed dynamically. One figure stands with a slight lean and tilted head, while the other appears to be mid-step, with one foot raised as if walking. Both figures have sketchily rendered facial features and dark, loose hair. They are draped in flowing robes that cascade to the floor. The background is plain, and the overall composition is monochrome, likely pen and ink.

artworks.title: An Unkind Wish
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with watercolor on wove paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing titled "An Unkind Wish". It features two figures in a humorous style. One figure is on the left, wearing baggy clothing and a hat, while the other figure on the right is tall and thin, wearing a suit and top hat. The thin figure is holding a cane. Above them is a caption that reads, "May your Shadow never be less!" The drawing is signed by George Cruikshank. At the bottom, there are quick sketches of other figures engaged in various activities. The artwork uses simple lines with some watercolor washes.

artworks.title: A Landscape with Figures Walking along a Path
artworks.medium: Blue watercolor with gray and black wash on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape scene with undulating hills, trees, and a winding path. The horizon is slightly above the center. The brushstrokes are expressive, capturing details with gestural dashes. The color palette includes browns, grays, creamy whites, and light blue. Figures can be seen on the path. The sky is filled with textured clouds.

artworks.title: A Landscape with a Great Tree
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash over graphite on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape drawn in an oval frame. The view is slightly elevated, offering a wide vista. The horizon is high in the composition, merging with distant rocky formations. The brushstrokes are loose and curvilinear, creating a dynamic presence. The color palette is warm with sepia tones. A tree is prominently featured, casting soft shadows. The landscape includes slopes and vegetation with a blend of light and shadow. The background is soft and undefined, keeping the focus on the lines and colors.

artworks.title: Two Studies of a Man
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash over black chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows two men. On the left, a man in a cloak and wide-brimmed hat is facing away. On the right, another man sits wearing a similar outfit, holding a cane. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Soldiers Fighting
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink over black chalk and traces of red chalk, laid down
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a battle scene with horsemen and warriors. The composition depicts a chaotic and dynamic confrontation with several figures, both on horseback and on foot. The central section shows two horseback riders engaged in combat, wielding weapons. Around them, there are figures on foot, some in aggressive postures, holding swords and shields, while others lie on the ground. The drawing uses fine lines and shading to convey motion and intensity, and the figures are rendered with exaggerated, muscular forms typical of dynamic battle representations. The background appears empty, emphasizing the action in the foreground.

artworks.title: A Stage Set with a Statue and a Palace
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with gray wash on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a castle with a circular tower, a statue positioned on a pedestal on a path leading to the castle entrance. Tall trees flank the path, forming a natural archway. The castle walls have fortified turrets and an ornate gateway with intricate stonework and carvings. In the background, there are more trees and faint outlines of hills. The scene is in a monochromatic sepia tone, emphasizing depth and detail with subtle shading variations.

artworks.title: Two Grenadiers
artworks.medium: brush and brown wash with pen and brown ink over graphite on wove paper laid down on album sheet
artworks.description: The image features two men in military uniform engaging closely with each other. Both are shown from head to toe. The man on the left stands with his left leg forward, holding a rifle, and has his right arm around the shoulder of the other man. The man on the right has his right leg slightly bent, supporting his weight, and is holding a sword in his left hand. Each man has distinctive facial features. Both wear tall, elaborate military hats and detailed uniforms. The man on the left displays a strap over his shoulder, while the man on the right has intricate decorations on his jacket and trousers. In the background, there are a few more soldiers and part of a building to the left. The setting is monochromatic.

artworks.title: Two Draped Figures
artworks.medium: pen and iron gall ink with brown wash over black chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two abstract figures. The image shows two figures standing and dressed in flowing garments. The figures are sketched with loose, expressive lines. There is a contrast between the two figures in terms of detail; the figure on the right is drawn with more clarity and distinction, while the figure on the left appears more abstract and ethereal. The background is plain.

artworks.title: A Rocky Landscape with a Stone Tower and a Waterfall
artworks.medium: red chalk over traces of graphite on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with rugged terrain, rocky outcrops, trees, softly rolling hills, and a castle or fort in the distance. The scene is presented in a monochromatic palette of sepia tones. The drawing uses detailed linework to depict textures such as foliage, stone, and water. A bridge crosses over a waterfall, with trees and clouds in the sky.

artworks.title: A Landscape Near Pecchio
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink over faint traces of graphite, within a border line by the artist, on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a cow walking along a winding path. There are detailed trees on either side, a distant village with a tower, rolling hills, mountains in the background, and a monochromatic, etching-like style in varying shades of brown.

artworks.title: Figure Studies, Including One Man Sleeping on the Ground and Two Men Sawing
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with gray wash on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of various scenes involving motion and rest. The drawing depicts a group of figures engaging in different activities and states. There is a figure lying on the ground, possibly sleeping or resting with clothing draped over them. Two figures in the center are interacting with a saw, with one holding the saw and the other observing or assisting. Below them, another figure leans on a workbench or cutting station, appearing contemplative or relaxed. To the right, two figures are standing together, with their hands in their pockets. Another figure stands alone with chains. The drawing captures both activity and repose within a static composition. The lines are clear and defined, providing a strong sense of the movements and stances of each figure.

artworks.title: A Landscape with a Domed Building
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a scene of a person standing on a path between clusters of trees on a hill, overlooking a city with a central dome architecture. In the background, there are soft mountains defining the skyline. The artwork is done in fine, detailed linework resembling etching, with cross-hatching for textures and shading. The color palette is monochromatic, using brown ink on cream paper.

artworks.title: A Portrait of a Queen and a Study of a Woman Seated on a Cloud; verso, Sleeping Figure
artworks.medium: red chalk on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet: 15.2 x 19.3 cm (6 x 7 5/8 in.) (the lower right corner cut out)
artworks.description: The image displays a drawing featuring a partial view of a figure's face, focusing on the person's head and shoulders turned slightly to the right. The individual has delicate facial features and their hair is styled intricately with curls and a possible bun, adorned with decorative elements. They are wearing clothing with a ruffled collar. Next to this portrait is a drawn figure of a mythical or classical character, shown in a reclining position with an arm raised above the head, draped in flowing fabric. The background is a textured paper aged with hints of wear, showcasing these sketches in red chalk or a similar medium, giving the illustration a classical ambiance. Some text is visible in the top portion but is partially obscured and difficult to read. The bottom right corner of the image has a patch of similar paper, adding an element of restoration or preservation to the artwork.

artworks.title: Studies for a Biblical Scene with God the Father Appearing to a Bearded Male Figure
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch with several full-length figures in different poses. In the top left corner, a draped figure is mid-motion with an extended arm. To the right, another figure faces left with a turned head and arms spread. Above them, a face emerges from swirling lines. In the top right corner, a reclining figure is embedded in a cloud-like formation with arms stretched outward. Below, another figure stands in a flowing robe. The background has swirling patterns resembling clouds or smoke with varied shading, creating a dynamic and ethereal atmosphere.

artworks.title: A Dramatic Scene with a Fainting Woman
artworks.medium: graphite with gray wash, heightened with white gouache (partially oxidized) on blue wove paper
artworks.description: The image is a sketch showing a group of people in dynamic positions. The individuals have sketchy and impressionistic facial features and hairstyles. They are dressed in loose garments, some with patterns or stains. The background includes architectural elements like pillars and arches. The color scheme is primarily grey and blue with hints of red and white.

artworks.title: The Education of the Virgin
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash over graphite on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows two figures seated together, with only the upper portions of their bodies visible. One figure is an older person with a raised arm, pointing upwards, defined facial features, a head covering, and holding an open book. The other figure is a younger person with smaller features, gently resting against the older individual, and looking upwards. Both figures wear draped clothing, set against a background with faint clouds and cherubic figures. The image has a sepia tone.

artworks.title: Leiche (Corpse)
artworks.medium: pen and black ink on laid paper
artworks.description: This abstract artwork showcases thin, erratic black lines intersecting and weaving across a pale background. The lines form small, irregular clusters. Some shapes appear like tilted, angular forms towards the left, while the right side features lighter, brush-like strokes.

artworks.title: The Fall of Phaeton
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink over graphite on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene featuring a muscular figure carrying a large structure on its back. The lines are fluid and expressive, conveying a sense of motion and weight. The figure's form expresses tension and physical exertion, with bold strokes creating a dramatic and urgent feel. The structure has decorative elements, giving it a classical appearance. The spiraling contours around the figure suggest powerful movement and struggle.
